adaptive_substrate_ablations.rule: set ds/dt=0 and hold s(t)=s0 while x and q evolve
set dq/dt=0 and hold q(t)=q0 while x and s evolve

collective_statistic_control.definition: For each configuration, generate c_ref(t) from the paired MF reference trajectory at RK4 dt/4, then replace endogenous c(x) in a control run with piecewise-linear interpolation of c_ref(t) on the 0.01 observation grid.
restrictions: The replay signal is generated independently within each split and configuration.
No smoothing, phase shifting, rescaling, or fitted lag is allowed.
The control is paired and descriptive; it is not one of the four canonical models.

graph_structure_manifest.future_requirement: A physical graph-incidence intervention requires a versioned contract amendment and cannot be added after pilot inspection.
graph_structure_manifest.reason: The frozen model family uses the complete three-node graph; it has no non-isomorphic three-node structural variant without changing the model contract.

relabeling_tripwire.pass_rule: after inverse permutation, every recorded observation agrees within the numerical convergence threshold
relabeling_tripwire.role: software invariance tripwire only; permutations are not independent inferential units

soft_penalty_control.future_requirement: May be introduced only by a versioned protocol amendment before confirmatory execution.
